# routeros_tool_sms (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_sms" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_number` (String)
- `channel` (Number)
- `polling` (Boolean) Poll new SMS every 5s. It's recommended to enable polling only when there are problems with receiving new SMS otherwise.
- `port` (String)
- `receive_enabled` (Boolean)
- `remove_sent_sms_after_send` (Boolean) Useful when modem automatically stores sent SMS.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `sim_pin` (String, Sensitive)
- `sms_storage` (String) Memory for reading, writing, sending and receiving operations (<mem1>, <mem2> and <mem3> in ETSI TS 127 005), will be used in further +CPMS commands (setting effective when using AT commands only).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_ussd` (String)
- `status` (String)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_tool_sms.settings .
```
